suites.name: Smoke / project entry
suites.assertions: Project create, intent, uncertainty state, clarification
suites.gate: Blocking for state corruption or false fact

suites.name: Context and Story Brain
suites.trigger: Context resolver, retrieval, memory or prompt changes
suites.assertions: Authorized context manifest, project isolation, current Canon preference

suites.name: Research and grounding
suites.trigger: Research provider, retrieval, chunking, prompt changes
suites.assertions: Provenance, conflicts, claim support, research-to-story separation

suites.name: Narrative task quality
suites.assertions: Character consistency, brief/format adherence, reviewer rubric
suites.gate: No high-severity score 0; gate pending approval

suites.name: Canon / approval / branch invariants
suites.assertions: No unauthorized mutation; branch isolation; optimistic concurrency; audit

suites.name: Package and continuity
suites.trigger: Package schema, dependency graph, continuity changes
suites.assertions: Readiness blockers, impact traceability, partial status

suites.name: Security / privacy / injection
suites.assertions: Tenant/project isolation, injection, provider gate, deletion propagation

suites.name: Reliability / recovery / observability
suites.trigger: Async worker, retry, queue, logging, run-state changes
suites.assertions: Timeout, quota, partial success, audit completeness
suites.gate: No state corruption; visible recoverable failure

suites.name: Cost / latency / reproducibility
suites.assertions: Usage attribution, latency decomposition, repeated trial analysis
suites.gate: Baseline and budget must be approved before numeric gate

suites.name: Full end-to-end release suite
suites.assertions: Cross-capability workflow plus all critical invariant tests
suites.gate: No unresolved critical blocker; report all unrun cases

note: Proposed manifest. Values are gate defaults requiring accountable approval; this file contains no run results.
